text: Saṅkhāre na pajānanti || saṅkhārasamudayam na pajānanti || saṅkhāranirodhaṃ na pajānanti || saṅkhāranirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ na pajānanti || pe|| || Pajānanti || pe|| || sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantīti || || Ekādasamam || || Samaṇabrāhmaṇa-vaggo aṭṭhamo || || Tassuddānaṃ || || Paccayekādasā vuttā || catusaccavibhajjanā || Samaṇabrāhmaṇavaggo || nidāne bhavati aṭṭhamaṃ || || Ayaṃ vaggassa uddānaṃ || || Buddho Āhāra Dasabalaṃ || Kaḷāraṃ Gahapati pañcamam || Rukkhavaggo Mahāvaggo || Aṭṭhamam Samaṇa-brāhmaṇanti || || CHAPTER IX ANTARA-PEYYĀLAṂ Sāvatthiyam viharati || ||
